content: 1. Store the medication in its original container at room temperature, away from light and moisture. 2. Do not store the medication in the bathroom. 3. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. 4. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 5. This information was last revised in May 2024. 6. This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. 7. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. 10. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. 11. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. 12. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 13. Nelfinavir may slow the removal of other medications from your body, potentially affecting how they work. 14. Other medications may affect the removal of nelfinavir from your body, which could alter its effectiveness. 15. Examples of such medications include apalutamide, certain anti-seizure drugs (e.g., carbamazepine, phenobarbital, primidone), rifampin, and St. John’s Wort. 16. This medication may reduce the effectiveness of hormonal birth control methods such as pills, patches, or rings, potentially leading to pregnancy. 17. Discuss with your doctor or pharmacist whether you should use reliable backup birth control methods while taking this medication. 18. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. 19. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. 20. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222 for poison control assistance. 21. Laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., liver function, viral load, T-cell counts, triglycerides/cholesterol, blood sugar) should be conducted while you are taking this medication. 22. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. 23. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. 24. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the regular time. 25.
